description: Full-domain compromise paths: Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, DCSync, Pass-the-Ticket, constrained and unconstrained delegation abuse, ACL and trust-relationship attacks.
Manual-first testing well past the OWASP Top 10: injection, SSRF, deserialization, auth and session flaws, business-logic abuse and chained exploitation.
Enumeration and vulnerability assessment across large, segmented enterprise environments — finding the one exposed service that opens the rest.
Custom offensive tooling and automation for recon pipelines, scanning workflows and cryptographic utilities.
Building multi-domain lab environments for adversary simulation, detection research and technique validation before they ever touch a client.
